shortDesc: Custom encryption algorithm built from scratch — exploring novel cryptographic primitives for secure data transmission.
fullDesc:
An early sandbox project exploring symmetric cryptographic algorithms and hashing mechanisms.

Core Idea:
This project acts as an early exploratory playground designed to understand how basic block ciphers are constructed. It implements custom bit-level permutations, key expansion routines, and non-linear substitution boxes (S-boxes) from first principles rather than relying on secure production libraries. The concepts and trials designed here directly laid the mathematical foundation for the more complete Enigma library.
highlights: Implemented basic block-cipher key derivation functions from scratch
Analyzed avalanche effects and bit-scrambling efficiency
Archived precursor sandbox for the Enigma encryption engine
